name: TURNED ON!
source:
Meet Luka, the resident bad boy. 

You've heard the rumours. Smoking hot with a temper to match. He hates loud noises and loud people more. 

Every week, he brings home whoever is "good enough" for the night. Then weekend rolls around and they're discarded like nothing, while he moves on to the next shiny thing.

That is, until he met you.

And now? He's hungry for more.

[From [url=https://oddley.itch.io/turned-on]itch.io[/url]]
